_comment: Dictionary evidence used to mark Mongolian bichig as dictionary-checked (scripts/mongolian_bichig.mjs). Fetched 2026-10-29 (UTC+8) during the Poppe/bichig audit. 'wiktionary': Traditional-script strings from the Mongolian section of the English Wiktionary page for this exact Cyrillic surface (kind 'headword' = from {{mn-...}} head templates; 'page-script' = any script string on the page, used only when the page has no head template). 'mongoltoli': headword bichig from mongoltoli.mn (Монгол хэлний их тайлбар толь, ШУА Хэл зохиолын хүрээлэн) for this exact surface queried as a lemma; only the first headword is returned for homographs. A surface counts as dictionary-checked only if the data's bichig equals one of these strings exactly, after normalising NNBSP/space to MVS (U+180E) and, for mongoltoli only, final YA (U+1836) to I (U+1822). FVS are NOT ignored. Neither source is a substitute for review by a reader of Traditional Mongolian; Wiktionary in particular is not authoritative.
